properties.description: Three parts, smallest first. (1) CAPTURE-TIME GUIDANCE: when a statement asserts what the system is right now, the capture path names TemporalFact rather than letting prose be the path of least resistance — subject_id is its only required property, and VALID_FROM / VALID_TO attach it to epochs. (2) A DETECTOR: a Requirement whose statement asserts current system state, with no TemporalFact and no VALID_TO, is unfalsifiable by construction and nothing reports it today. (3) AGE AT READ-BACK: where-am-i and search_design mark how old a node's factual half is, so a six-week-old observation is not narrated as current. Part 3 belongs with the read-half increment; parts 1 and 2 stand alone.
properties.name: Time-bound claims land in a TemporalFact, and age is visible where claims are read
